level.description: L0: Local only, L1: Structured semantic context, L2: Sanitized visual crop, L3: Sanitized full screen

reason.description: Justification for this disclosure level based on task complexity and sensitivity

task.description: The user task intent being resolved

elements.description: Sanitized element descriptors permitted for transmission

crop_box.description: [x, y, width, height] viewport coordinates for L2 visual crop

screenshot_data.description: Base64 encoded sanitized/redacted PNG image data (used only in L2/L3)

redacted_token_count.description: Number of PII/secret spans replaced with placeholder tokens in this disclosure

label.description: Sanitized text label with PII masked as tokens like [PERSON_1], [EMAIL]
